name: E-FeOOH
notes: Imported 12.08.2026 from a beamline jcpds collection. Source file(s): JCPDS/dac_user_jcpds/FeOOH-pmn21.jcpds. Cell axes and hkl were permuted into the P21nm setting without changing d-spacings. The positional model is the 20 GPa static structure of Insixiengmay and Stixrude, American Mineralogist 108, 2209-2222 (2023), doi:10.2138/am-2022-8839, selected because its volume is closest to the imported high-pressure cell.

eos_records.label: Gleason et al. (2008), second-order BM
eos_records.notes: Gleason et al. report V0 = 66.3 +/- 0.5 A^3 and K0 = 158 +/- 5 GPa; K0' is fixed to 4 by the second-order Birch-Murnaghan equation.
